* Complementary-input two-stage OTA
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* Ten microampere reference and mirrored input pair tails
XNB IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1
XNR PREF IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=1
XPB PREF PREF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1
XNT TN IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=76 l=4 m=2
XPT TP PREF VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=80 l=2 m=3
* NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load
XN1 DN VINN TN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.2
XN2 DN2 NGIN TN VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1.2
XP3 DN DN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=95 l=1
XP4 V1 DN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=95 l=1
XP5 DN2 DN2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=95 l=1
XP6 DB2 DN2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=95 l=1
XN5 DB2 DB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=95 l=1 m=2
XN6 V1 DB2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=48.6875 l=1 m=4
* PMOS pair, NMOS mirror load
XP1 DP VINN TP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.8 m=6
XP2 V1 PGIN TP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.8 m=6
XN3 DP DP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=1
XN4 V1 DP VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=60 l=1
* Inverting second stage and Miller compensation
XOUTN VOUT V1 NS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=15 l=0.5 m=10
XOUTP VOUT V1 PS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5 m=10
RNS NS VSS 2k
RPS PS VDD 5k
CBP PS VDD 2p
XPFF SW DN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1
XPDI RR RR SW VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=10 l=1
RFF RR V1 300k
RZ V1 VC 16800
CC VC VOUT 5.2p
RPG VINP PGIN 35k
RNG VINP NGIN 43k
CNG NGIN VSS 0.5p
XZR V1 VDD VC VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=1
RBLEED VOUT VDD 50k
.ends DUT
